title: Childhood in Scandinavia
author: Barbara Almond M.D.
summary: This summer my husband and I took a trip to Scandinavia to see the beautiful scenery and to experience life in a social democracy, to the degree that a casual visitor can-and incidentally, to watch children and their parents.

# Childhood in Scandinavia

> This summer my husband and I took a trip to Scandinavia to see the beautiful scenery and to experience life in a social democracy, to the degree that a casual visitor can-and incidentally, to watch children and their parents.
